stem: A task can be completed only by bypassing a protective device on powered equipment. What should a Technician I learner do?
choices: Stop and escalate because bypassing the safeguard exceeds routine authorized work and can expose the worker to hazardous energy or moving parts.
Use the bypass only for the minimum time needed to finish the task, then restore the safeguard.
Have a more experienced coworker operate the equipment while the safeguard is bypassed.
Proceed if the equipment has a good safety history and no abnormal condition is visible.
rationale: A protective device is part of the equipment's hazard-control system. Technician I should not bypass it to keep production moving or transfer the risk to another coworker. If the task cannot be completed safely with the safeguard in place, the work should stop and be escalated through the authorized servicing process.
